text:
Maya L.: Quick heads-up — pulled the week-1 post-launch pulse deck, looks like conversions dipped on Tues afternoon. Anyone else see a weird cohort blip?
Owen G.: Yep saw it in the dashboard. Source looks like 'webinar-reg' → high dropoff on the /pricing page.
Riley (growth): I think this is the attribution window messing with counts — GA4 vs HubSpot are misaligned for that event.
Samir: Can you paste the query you used? I want to check join keys.
Maya L.: SQL I used: ```SELECT event_date, source, count(distinct user_id) as users FROM raw.events WHERE event IN ('signup','pricing_view') AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-08' AND '2026-03-14' GROUP BY 1,2```
Jae Park: Ops-bot just finished refresh: "ops-bot: dashboard refresh complete, dataset v3 loaded (etl-run-id: 20260314-b)."
Riley (growth): K — I re-ran with a 7d attribution window vs 30d. 7d shows the dip, 30d smooths it out. Could be delayed attribution from our email nurture.
Owen G.: Interesting. Which campaigns were live that week? We had a small paid LinkedIn push on 3/10 and the webinar nurture send on 3/11.
Maya L.: Webinar registrants from 3/11 had a higher-than-usual bounce on pricing. Maybe messaging mismatch between webinar CTA and pricing page copy.
Samir: Can we verify by split of first-touch vs last-touch? If last-touch drops but first-touch steady, that supports messaging flow issue.
Riley (growth): I exported a quick table to show first_touch_source vs conversion_rate: first-touch from webinar actually has 8% higher initial engagement but 22% lower checkout conversion compared to organic.
Jae Park: Suggestion: add a quick AB test on pricing CTA copy for those email cohorts. If copy is the issue we should see CTR lift within a week.
Maya L.: Agreed. Also let's flag this for next weekly KPI review — want to show both raw counts and the 7/14/30d attribution windows side-by-side.
Owen G.: I'll update the dashboard: new toggle for attribution window + a little note about which systems (GA4/HubSpot) feed which metric.
Samir: Also add a small table for webinar -> pricing funnel by cohort (email send date). I'll upload the query to the shared queries folder.
Riley (growth): Quick FYI: pulled session recordings for 3/11-3/13 and a handful of users expected pricing features that aren't highlighted. So UX confound possible too.
Maya L.: Good catch. So action items: 1) Owen adds window toggle and annotation; 2) Samir uploads cohort funnel query; 3) Jae drafts CTA variants for AB test; 4) Riley shares session snippets in the huddle doc.
Owen G.: ETA on dashboard changes? Today EOD?
Samir: I'll have the query in by 5pm PT.
Jae Park: CTA drafts by tomorrow noon.
Riley (growth): Session clips uploaded to the huddle doc in an hour.
Maya L.: Perfect. For the weekly KPI review on Friday, can we include a one-slide snapshot showing: conversions by attribution window, webinar cohort performance, and AB test plan?
Owen G.: Yep — I'll add that slide to the pulse deck.
ops-bot: Reminder: "ops-bot: Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00am — calendar invite sent to #marketing."
Maya L.: Thanks — ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup: 
Owen G.: Thanks all, will post update thread when dashboard is live.
Riley (growth): Thanks — leaning toward hypothesis: messaging → UX → lower conversion. AB test will help isolate. :mag:
